pythonFunction.name: get_bill_history
pythonFunction.description:
Returns the customer's bill amounts for up to the last 12 months, oldest first, shaped for the bill trend
card (period label, amount, is_current) with a highlight note against last month. Use it for bill trend
questions; get_billing_history is for the details of recent bills. Needs an identified caller. Before calling
this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Leave empty: the identified account is used automatically (any other id is refused).
    months: How many months to return, 2 to 13; the default is 12.
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, months (period, period_key, amount, is_current; oldest first), highlight_note,
    current_amount, previous_amount, change_amount, same_month_last_year_amount, card (the
    show_bill_trend_card arguments) and spoken_summary.
